text:
maria (PM): Quick check-in: customers pushing for Private Deploy roadmap clarity. Key asks: VPC handoff for customer-managed egress, zero-downtime upgrades, and clear GA acceptance.

alex (Eng): Agree. We need three lanes: Minimal installer GA, Upgrade-aware operator (Beta), Full VPC handoff (post-GA).

lisa (Field): Field urgency: top accounts require preserved egress IPs or they'll delay. They suggested either sticky SNAT in their VPC or an owned relay.

netops-jordan: Tech tradeoffs: sticky SNAT appliance is customer-ops heavy but private. Relay is easier for customers but creates privacy/legal work. BGP is complex.

sam (SRE): Define "zero-downtime": target <1% 5xxs, KV miss <0.5%, rollback <10m. Need canary automation to validate.

security-elena: Relay option needs privacy assessment; mark as blocked until legal signs off.

maria (PM): Plan: Minimal installer GA in 2 sprints; Operator shim Beta in 4 sprints with feature-flag IP_PRESERVE_MODE; VPC handoff after security/legal signoff (Q4).

alex (Eng): Action: I'll spike KV hot-transfer POC and a demo script showing node swap in 10 days.

netops-jordan: Action: draft risk matrix for SNAT vs relay vs BGP in 5 days. Will include customer guidance (single-AZ vs multi-AZ).

lisa (Field): I'll collect customer windows and list top 6 who must join Beta. Need rollback checklist + SE oncall coverage.

sam (SRE): I'll draft canary playbook and automated thresholds. Include load-test gate for GA.

maria (PM): I'll write RFC with lanes, ACs, owners, and timelines by EOD. If any dependency shifts, flag it here.

alex (Eng): One Q: can we gate enabling IP_PRESERVE_MODE behind a Beta flag to avoid GA risk?

maria (PM): Yes, Beta-only flag. Document caveats.

netops-jordan: Note: relay increases latency slightly; include perf budget in RFC.

lisa (Field): :thumbsup: field aligned with ordering if shim Beta is available for critical customers.

maria (PM): Closing for now. RFC link will follow.
